title: Vivian Blank 19
author: bpatrick
body: As Och said, don’t let the haircut fool you.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: randomjackass: What a misnomer. Mind if I call you “greattasteincomicsguy” or “adeptatrecognizingawesomeness”? Seriously though, thank you!

comments.author: RandomJackass
comments.text: Seriously though, it’s a bit quiet around here in the comments. But I check this site nearly daily, and I know a lot of other people who do too. Good luck with the comics, when is the next Curious Urgency coming out?

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: It is really quiet in the comments — thanks for breaking the silence. And thanks for checking the site. It sounds like people want to see Vivian Blank updated for awhile but after that Curious Urgency is up next.
